name: Spaghetti Marinara with Chicken, Kale & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes, then drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels and medium dice.
When the onion is soft, increase heat to medium-high. Add chicken to the pot and sauté until just cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 2-3 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (283 g) bags kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Add marinara to the pot, stir to combine, and cook until warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
Add pasta to the pot with the sauce and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and sprinkle with Parmesan. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use
